segments.title: The biggest cave: how TALL inside?
segments.say: Earth's biggest cave. How tall does it get inside? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: Up to about 200 METERS!
segments.say: Up to about two hundred meters! That's around six hundred fifty five feet.

segments.title: It's Son Doong
segments.say: It's called Son Doong, in Vietnam.

segments.title: Jungles grow INSIDE
segments.say: Where the roof collapsed, sunlight gets in, and jungles grow inside.

segments.title: It makes its own mist
segments.say: It's so big it has its own climate, with clouds of mist.

segments.title: Source: National Geographic
segments.say: Sources: National Geographic and Live Science.
